title: LP2-31: periodic IoC for periods 2-20
question: Does the maximum pooled column IoC over periods 2-20 exceed the fixed-multiset shuffle reference?
summary: Period 13 is the observed peak, but 213 of 999 shuffled maxima are at least as large; corrected Monte Carlo p=0.214.

scope.representation: 269 archived runes; headings included; non-alphabet characters removed; no corrections.
scope.procedure: Pool within-residue-column pair counts, maximize over periods, compare against identically scanned uniform multiset shuffles.
scope.parameters: Periods 2-20 inclusive; offset zero; 999 trials; seed 330131; >= ties; plus-one Monte Carlo correction; alpha 0.05.
scope.exclusions: Other pages, periods outside 2-20, regional variants, corrected streams, word/punctuation-preserving nulls, decryption and key searches.

finding: 269 archived runes; unique maximum at period 13, 216/5300. Across 999 shuffles, 213 maxima meet or exceed it; p=0.214, not below the declared 0.05 threshold.
limitations: Only LP2-31, complete archived stream, periods 2-20. Null preserves counts but not local structure. No adjustment for page selection or prior work. No cipher classification or key recovered.
next_steps: Human review remains open. Other pages, transcription choices, period ranges, and null models require separately planned variants in this family.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12.10, standard library, Windows; independent check: python experiments/records/lp2-31-periodic-ioc/check.py

review.reviewer: Codex — computational retest and code review; human review pending

family.title: Periodic IoC with a shuffle comparison
